$comment: Authoritative source and delivery path for public alpha.school field families. Unknown items fail closed. Human form: docs/website-architecture.md and playbook/00-how-to-use.md.

fields.refresh: n8n campus flow daily at 00:15 Central; map schedule documented in content-pipelines
fields.conflictRule: HubSpot wins over Operations and the map mirror
fields.verify: HubSpot readback, delivery run, canonical campus page, map output

fields.sourceLocator: Program name and location identity fields
fields.conflictRule: Program names at the top are not editable by website operators
fields.verify: exact Program ID join and public identity checks

fields.sourceLocator: school_address, grade fields, tuition_usd_yearly, contact_number, email
fields.refresh: n8n campus flow daily at 00:15 Central; APEX HubSpot readback about every 30 minutes
fields.conflictRule: Correct HubSpot, not Elementor; grade-property choice remains a recorded decision
fields.verify: source readback followed by canonical page and related surface verification

fields.refresh: daily at 00:15 Central unless the owner runs it manually
fields.conflictRule: Do not make a durable direct Elementor fix; derivation from Program.type remains proposed
fields.verify: HubSpot readback, n8n execution, next-run survival, canonical page

fields.conflictRule: Application routing is not inferred from a campus name
fields.verify: logged-out CTA, submission_campus routing, destination and confirmation behavior

surface: Book a Call or calendar CTA
fields.authority: HubSpot Programs or named calendar owner, depending on the field
fields.conflictRule: Use the field map for the exact CTA; do not strip valid analytics query parameters during verification

fields.authority: approved APEX ticket plus campus role owner
fields.sourceLocator: ticket name, title, biography, explicit person-to-asset mapping, effective date
delivery: Alpha MCP for recognized existing staff structures
allowedEditors: scheduled APEX agent for supported operations
fields.conflictRule: Never infer identity from a photo and never create or clone a carousel
fields.verify: same-card name, title, biography, photo, order, absent old value, canonical page

fields.sourceLocator: public flag, program interest, event type, title, time, timezone, registration link
fields.refresh: about every 30 minutes; observer allows up to two hours
fields.conflictRule: Do not hand-edit imported posts or hide events by changing an unrelated source flag
fields.verify: plugin log, imported post, aggregate page, campus strip, registration destination

fields.authority: approved media registry or exact APEX attachment
delivery: Alpha MCP media and content tools when supported
fields.conflictRule: Exact campus and person mapping; Slack or Drive is not fetched directly by the version 1 agent
fields.verify: attachment identity, hash, rendered source, crop and mobile review

fields.sourceLocator: Canva master, campus facts, Flipsnack publication and registry/campus-packets.json
fields.conflictRule: Do not link an unapproved packet; interim visibility policy is still proposed
fields.verify: logged-out public document, correct campus and year, canonical CTA

fields.sourceLocator: exact HubSpot Program ID join to Community record and slug
fields.conflictRule: Never infer the slug from the campus name and never change another surface as a side effect
fields.verify: identity join, visible program, logged-out route and selected campus

surface: Alpha Answers index and detail experience
delivery: Alpha Answers import endpoint or workflow
fields.conflictRule: Canonical grouping and schema validation must be confirmed before unattended writes
fields.verify: import receipt, canonical entry count, detail navigation, sitemap and LLM export eligibility

surface: page-owned copy, links and media not listed as synchronized
fields.authority: approved APEX ticket and named content owner
fields.sourceLocator: ticket replacement, approved source or registry entry
delivery: Alpha MCP content or post-field tools when actor support exists
allowedEditors: scheduled agent only when capability matrix says integrated
fields.conflictRule: Check the campus field map and source registry before classifying content as direct
fields.verify: exact present and absent checks, whole-page and visual review

fields.authority: approved page-family requirement and the field-specific source
fields.sourceLocator: Yoast fields, WordPress status, template or n8n campus metadata mapping
delivery: WordPress, Yoast, Elementor template or n8n
fields.conflictRule: Identify whether Yoast, a template, WordPress, or n8n owns the exact field before editing
fields.verify: rendered metadata, canonical, schema validation, sitemap and indexability

fields.authority: named global component or platform owner
fields.sourceLocator: Elementor theme templates, menus, plugin configuration and custom code
fields.conflictRule: Never edit under a campus-content ticket; use staging and ring-3 verification
fields.verify: target surface plus at least two untouched representative pages
